newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Land says Jul-Dec '96 net up.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Land says Jul-Dec '96 net up.

text.p: Indonesia property firm PT Lippo Land Development said on Tuesday it posted a net profit of 40.6 billion rupiah in the six months ended December 1996 against 24.18 billion rupiah in the same period in 1995.
The company also said it posted earnings per share of 163 rupiah.

"Our strong first half performance is a reflection of the continued success of our urban townships. We are continuing our focus on our core business -- urban development," the company said in an advertisement in the Bisnis Indonesia newspaper.
